summary: The DGA breadcrumb: a where-am-I trail at the top of a page below the header. Earlier crumbs with a link are router links; the current page is plain text.

inputs.name: items
inputs.type: readonly DgaBreadcrumbItem[] ({ label, link?, icon?, current? })
inputs.description: The crumbs in order; labels are translated. Without a crumb marked current, the last one is the current page.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark (translated).

a11y: WAI-ARIA breadcrumb pattern: a nav landmark named by label holding an ordered list; the current crumb has aria-current=page. Separators are decorative chevrons that point along the reading direction and mirror in RTL. Needs the Angular router (RouterLink).
